releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- you can no longer warp your ship with you to the vessel. now you are required to get out of your ship first before warping!
- the pause menu actually enables/disables itself in real time according to whether you talked to gabbro or not, allowing it to be even more lore friendly.

releases.name: Initial Release! V1.0.0
releases.body: Uploads Warp to Vessel Mod to Github
